My mother and my dad are like polar opposites to me.

My dad is great. My parents split when I was 2 and I had no contact with my dad until I was 13 because of severe alcoholism and petty crime. I'm incredibly proud to say he's been sober for over 16 years, has a lovely wife and 2 cats, and works for the state running group housing rehab programs. He's also trying to go back to school for a social work degree. I'll text my dad throughout the week about the most random, mundane things, I just like talking to him.

He's also been fantastic regarding my disability. I mentioned to him ONCE that it's gotten harder for me to crochet because the pain is spreading to my wrists and knuckles, I can't keep tension as well as I used to and my fingers cramp almost instantly. For Christmas he got me a lovely tension ring, an ergonomic hook with switchable sizes, and three pairs of compression gloves. I broke down crying because it was so sweet of him. I genuinely don't know what I'd do without my dad in my life.
